description: This PHP class implements an interface to determine if the timesheet period is defined, which influences homepage behavior for users in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: TimesheetPeriodDefinedHomePageEnabler
classes.description: This class checks whether the timesheet period is defined to control homepage behavior.

methods.name: getConfigService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the ConfigService instance.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Determines if the homepage feature should be enabled based on whether the timesheet period is defined.
